name: Flash white
summary: Quick full-frame white flash with adjustable attack and decay; for hits, camera pops and beat accents.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: decay
params.note: frames to fade back out after the peak

author: krakujs
